# Website Quality Audit: UNILOV Catering Portfolio Page  

## Overall Layout & Structure  
The page follows a **clean, professional layout** with a fixed header and a centered content section. The header spans the full width of the viewport, while the main content (portfolio) is contained within a centered container (approx. 1100–1200px wide) to ensure readability. The layout is structured as:  
- **Header**: Logo, navigation menu, and contact info.  
- **Hero Section**: Title ("Наши работы") and subtitle ("Фото с реальных мероприятий").  
- **Portfolio Grid**: 6 images arranged in a 2×3 grid (2 rows, 3 columns) with consistent spacing.  


## Header Details  
- **Logo**: Positioned at the top-left, featuring the brand name "UNILOV" in a stylized serif font (gold color) with "CATERIN" in smaller, uppercase sans-serif text below it.  
- **Navigation Menu**: Horizontal menu at the top-center, with 8 items: "Форматы", "Фуршет", "Банкет", "Свадьба", "Меню", "Калькулятор", "Контакты". All text is in uppercase, sans-serif, and white (consistent with the dark header background).  
- **Contact Info**: Phone number "+7 (812) 919-59-11" at the top-right, in white sans-serif font.  
- **Background**: Solid black (#000000), creating high contrast with white/gold text.  


## Main Content (Portfolio Section)  
### Typography  
- **Title**: "Наши работы" (Our Works) in a large, elegant serif font (gold color, ~36–40px), centered.  
- **Subtitle**: "Фото с реальных мероприятий" (Photos from real events) in smaller, uppercase sans-serif font (white, ~14px), centered below the title.  

### Image Grid  
- **Arrangement**: 6 high-quality food/event images in a 2×3 grid. Each image is rectangular (approx. 350×250px) with rounded corners (subtle, ~5px radius) for a modern look.  
- **Content**:  
  1. Top-left: Restaurant scene with a waiter, burgers, and plated dishes.  
  2. Top-middle: Dessert display (macarons, tarts, berries).  
  3. Top-right: Grilled steak with herbs and vegetables.  
  4. Bottom-left: Cocktails on a bar counter.  
  5. Bottom-middle: Seafood platter (oysters, shrimp, caviar).  
  6. Bottom-right: Formal table setting (plates, glasses, cutlery).  
- **Spacing**: Consistent 20–25px gaps between images and between the grid and page edges.  

### Background  
- Solid black (#000000), matching the header for visual consistency.  


## Visual Elements & UI  
- **WhatsApp Icon**: A green circular icon with the WhatsApp logo at the bottom-right (fixed position), likely a contact button.  
- **Logo/Brand Mark**: A small "N" logo at the bottom-left (possibly a footer or brand mark).  


## Color Scheme  
- **Primary**: Black (#000000) for the background (header + main content).  
- **Accent**: Gold (#D4AF37) for the logo and title (adds luxury, aligning with a catering brand).  
- **Text**: White (#FFFFFF) for navigation, subtitle, and contact info (high contrast against black).  


## Spacing & Alignment  
- **Header**: 20–30px padding top/bottom; 40–50px padding left/right.  
- **Navigation**: 15–20px spacing between menu items.  
- **Portfolio Grid**: 20–25px margin between images; 40–50px margin top/bottom from the header.  
- **Text Alignment**: All text (title, subtitle, navigation) is center-aligned for a balanced, professional look.  


## Visual Issues (None Detected)  
- **Contrast**: Excellent (black background + white/gold text meets WCAG standards).  
- **Image Quality**: All images are high-resolution, well-composed, and relevant to the catering theme.  
- **Responsiveness**: While not tested on mobile, the grid layout suggests it would adapt well (e.g., single-column on small screens).  


## Summary  
The page is **visually cohesive** with a luxury-focused design (black + gold) that effectively showcases the catering service’s portfolio. Typography, spacing, and imagery are consistent, and there are no apparent visual flaws. The layout prioritizes clarity and brand identity, making it easy for users to navigate and engage with the content.
